mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TEAMS t USING (SELECT #{teamId} AS TEAM_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (t.TEAM_ID = s.TEAM_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.TEAM_NAME = #{teamName}, t.EMBLEM_URL = NVL(#{emblemUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.EMBLEM_URL), t.HOME_GROUND = NVL(t.HOME_GROUND, NVL(#{homeGround, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '홈 경기장')), t.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TEAM_ID, TEAM_NAME, HISTORY, EMBLEM_URL, ANTHEM_URL, FOUNDED_YEAR, HOME_GROUND, UPDATED_AT) VALUES ( #{teamId}, #{teamName}, #{history, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{emblemUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{anthemUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASE WHEN #{foundedYear, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL THEN TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{foundedYear, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 4), 'YYYY') ELSE TO_DATE('1900', 'YYYY') END, NVL(#{homeGround, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '홈 경기장'), SYSTIMESTAMP )

MERGE INTO PLAYERS p USING (SELECT #{playerId} AS PLAYER_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (p.PLAYER_ID = s.PLAYER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p.NAME = #{name}, p.MAIN_POSITION = NVL(#{mainPosition, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, p.MAIN_POSITION), p.NATIONALITY = NVL(#{nationality, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, p.NATIONALITY), p.TEAM_ID = NVL(#{teamId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, p.TEAM_ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PLAYER_ID, NAME, MAIN_POSITION, NATIONALITY, TEAM_ID) VALUES ( #{playerId}, #{name}, #{mainPosition}, #{nationality, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teamId} )

MERGE INTO PLAYER_STATS ps USING (SELECT #{playerId} AS PLAYER_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (ps.PLAYER_ID = s.PLAYER_ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PLAYER_ID, GOALS, ASSISTS, YELLOW_CARDS, RED_CARDS, IS_INJURED, IS_SUSPENDED) VALUES (#{playerId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 'N', 'N')

MERGE INTO PLAYER_STATS ps USING (SELECT #{playerId} AS PLAYER_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (ps.PLAYER_ID = s.PLAYER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ps.GOALS = #{goals}, ps.ASSISTS = NVL(#{assists, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ps.ASSISTS) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PLAYER_ID, GOALS, ASSISTS, YELLOW_CARDS, RED_CARDS, IS_INJURED, IS_SUSPENDED) VALUES (#{playerId}, #{goals}, NVL(#{assists, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), 0, 0, 'N', 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT PLAYER_ID, NAME, NAME_KOR, MAIN_POSITION, NATIONALITY, NATIONALITY_KOR, TEAM_ID FROM PLAYERS WHERE TEAM_ID = #{teamId} ORDER BY CASE MAIN_POSITION WHEN 'GK' THEN 1 WHEN 'DF' THEN 2 WHEN 'MF' THEN 3 WHEN 'FW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, NAME ASC

SELECT TEAM_ID, TEAM_NAME, TEAM_NAME_KOR, HISTORY, EMBLEM_URL, ANTHEM_URL, TO_CHAR(FOUNDED_YEAR, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS FOUNDED_YEAR, HOME_GROUND, HOME_GROUND_KOR, UPDATED_AT FROM TEAMS WHERE TEAM_ID = #{teamId}

SELECT TEAM_ID, TEAM_NAME, TEAM_NAME_KOR, HISTORY, EMBLEM_URL, ANTHEM_URL, TO_CHAR(FOUNDED_YEAR, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS FOUNDED_YEAR, HOME_GROUND, HOME_GROUND_KOR, UPDATED_AT FROM TEAMS ORDER BY TEAM_NAME ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TEAMS SET TEAM_NAME_KOR = #{teamNameKor, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HOME_GROUND = CASE WHEN (HOME_GROUND IS NULL OR HOME_GROUND = '홈 경기장') AND #{homeGround, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL THEN #{homeGround, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ELSE HOME_GROUND END, HOME_GROUND_KOR = #{homeGroundKor, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HISTORY = #{history, jdbcType=CLOB}, ANTHEM_URL = NVL(#{anthemUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ANTHEM_URL), UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE TEAM_ID = #{teamId}
UPDATE TEAMS SET ANTHEM_URL = #{anthemUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE TEAM_ID = #{teamId}
mapper.select: SELECT TEAM_ID, TEAM_NAME, TEAM_NAME_KOR, EMBLEM_URL FROM TEAMS WHERE EMBLEM_URL IS NULL OR EMBLEM_URL LIKE '%crests.football-data.org%' OR EMBLEM_URL NOT LIKE '%.png' ORDER BY TEAM_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TEAMS SET EMBLEM_URL = #{emblemUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE TEAM_ID = #{teamId}
mapper.select: SELECT PLAYER_ID, NAME, NAME_KOR, MAIN_POSITION, NATIONALITY, NATIONALITY_KOR, TEAM_ID FROM PLAYERS ORDER BY TEAM_ID ASC, PLAYER_ID ASC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO STAFFS s USING ( SELECT #{teamId} AS TEAM_ID, #{staffRoleId} AS STAFF_ROLE_ID FROM DUAL ) src ON (s.TEAM_ID = src.TEAM_ID AND s.STAFF_ROLE_ID = src.STAFF_ROLE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.NAME = #{name}, s.NATIONALITY = #{nationality, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (NAME, NATIONALITY, TEAM_ID, STAFF_ROLE_ID) VALUES ( #{name}, #{nationality, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teamId}, #{staffRoleId} )
mapper.select: SELECT s.STAFF_ID, s.NAME, s.NAME_KOR, s.NATIONALITY, s.NATIONALITY_KOR, s.TEAM_ID, s.STAFF_ROLE_ID, sr.ROLE_NAME FROM STAFFS s LEFT JOIN STAFF_ROLES sr ON s.STAFF_ROLE_ID = sr.STAFF_ROLE_ID ORDER BY s.TEAM_ID ASC, s.STAFF_ID ASC

SELECT s.STAFF_ID, s.NAME, s.NAME_KOR, s.NATIONALITY, s.NATIONALITY_KOR, s.TEAM_ID, s.STAFF_ROLE_ID, sr.ROLE_NAME FROM STAFFS s LEFT JOIN STAFF_ROLES sr ON s.STAFF_ROLE_ID = sr.STAFF_ROLE_ID WHERE s.TEAM_ID = #{teamId} ORDER BY s.STAFF_ROLE_ID ASC, s.NAME ASC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO STAFF_ROLES sr USING (SELECT #{staffRoleId} AS STAFF_ROLE_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (sr.STAFF_ROLE_ID = s.STAFF_ROLE_ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (STAFF_ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME) VALUES (#{staffRoleId}, #{roleName})

MERGE INTO TEAM_STATS ts USING ( SELECT #{teamId} AS TEAM_ID, #{season} AS SEASON FROM DUAL ) s ON (ts.TEAM_ID = s.TEAM_ID AND ts.SEASON = s.SEASON) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ts.CURRENT_RANK = #{currentRank, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ts.MATCHES_PLAYED = #{matchesPlayed}, ts.WINS = #{wins}, ts.DRAWS = #{draws}, ts.LOSSES = #{losses}, ts.POINTS = #{points}, ts.GOALS_FOR = #{goalsFor}, ts.GOALS_AGAINST = #{goalsAgainst}, ts.GOAL_DIFF = #{goalDiff}, ts.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TEAM_ID, SEASON, CURRENT_RANK, MATCHES_PLAYED, WINS, DRAWS, LOSSES, POINTS, GOALS_FOR, GOALS_AGAINST, GOAL_DIFF, YELLOW_CARDS, RED_CARDS, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{teamId}, #{season}, #{currentRank, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{matchesPlayed}, #{wins}, #{draws}, #{losses}, #{points}, #{goalsFor}, #{goalsAgainst}, #{goalDiff}, NVL(#{yellowCards, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), NVL(#{redCards, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT ts.TEAM_ID, ts.SEASON, ts.CURRENT_RANK, ts.MATCHES_PLAYED, ts.WINS, ts.DRAWS, ts.LOSSES, ts.POINTS, ts.GOALS_FOR, ts.GOALS_AGAINST, ts.GOAL_DIFF, ts.YELLOW_CARDS, ts.RED_CARDS, ts.UPDATED_AT, t.TEAM_NAME, t.EMBLEM_URL FROM TEAM_STATS ts JOIN TEAMS t ON ts.TEAM_ID = t.TEAM_ID WHERE ts.TEAM_ID = #{teamId} ORDER BY ts.SEASON DESC

SELECT ts.TEAM_ID, ts.SEASON, ts.CURRENT_RANK, ts.MATCHES_PLAYED, ts.WINS, ts.DRAWS, ts.LOSSES, ts.POINTS, ts.GOALS_FOR, ts.GOALS_AGAINST, ts.GOAL_DIFF, ts.YELLOW_CARDS, ts.RED_CARDS, ts.UPDATED_AT, t.TEAM_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.EMBLEM_URL FROM TEAM_STATS ts JOIN TEAMS t ON ts.TEAM_ID = t.TEAM_ID WHERE ts.SEASON = NVL(#{season, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 2026) ORDER BY ts.CURRENT_RANK ASC NULLS LAST, ts.POINTS DESC, ts.GOAL_DIFF DESC, ts.GOALS_FOR DESC

SELECT ps.PLAYER_ID, p.NAME AS PLAYER_NAME, p.NAME_KOR AS PLAYER_NAME_KOR, p.MAIN_POSITION, p.NATIONALITY, p.NATIONALITY_KOR, t.TEAM_ID, t.TEAM_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.EMBLEM_URL, ps.GOALS, ps.ASSISTS, ps.YELLOW_CARDS, ps.RED_CARDS, ps.IS_INJURED, ps.IS_SUSPENDED FROM PLAYER_STATS ps JOIN PLAYERS p ON ps.PLAYER_ID = p.PLAYER_ID JOIN TEAMS t ON p.TEAM_ID = t.TEAM_ID WHERE ps.GOALS > 0 ORDER BY ps.GOALS DESC, ps.ASSISTS DESC, p.NAME ASC FETCH FIRST NVL(#{limit, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 20) ROWS ONLY

SELECT ps.PLAYER_ID, p.NAME AS PLAYER_NAME, p.NAME_KOR AS PLAYER_NAME_KOR, p.MAIN_POSITION, p.NATIONALITY, p.NATIONALITY_KOR, t.TEAM_ID, t.TEAM_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.EMBLEM_URL, ps.GOALS, ps.ASSISTS, ps.YELLOW_CARDS, ps.RED_CARDS, ps.IS_INJURED, ps.INJURY_NOTE, ps.IS_SUSPENDED FROM PLAYER_STATS ps JOIN PLAYERS p ON ps.PLAYER_ID = p.PLAYER_ID JOIN TEAMS t ON p.TEAM_ID = t.TEAM_ID WHERE ps.PLAYER_ID = #{playerId}
